id1.description: An issue or obstacle which adversely impacts on the physical, mental and/or social well-being of an individual. The definition of a problem is deliberately kept rather loose so as to capture any real or perceived concerns that may adversely affect an individual's wellbeing to any degree.

id4.description: The date when the problem was first identified by the individual.

id5.description: The age of the individual when the problem was first identified by the individual.

id6.description: The assessed overall severity of the index problem.

at7.description: The severity of the index problem is mild, not affecting life or longevity.

at8.description: The severity of the index problem is such as to cause significant morbidity.

at9.description: The severity of the index problem has had a major effect on life and/or longevity.

id10.description: Description of the clinical aspects of the problem.

id11.description: Date the problem was recognised by a healthcare provider.

id12.description: Location of the problem in terms of body site.

id15.description: Agents or Factors known to have been of aetiological significance.

id16.description: Agent or other factor known to have caused this problem.

id17.description: Identification of a problem, injury or condition as text,coded text or link within the EHR.

id19.description: Grouping of information about individual occurrences or exacerbations.

id20.description: The frequency of individual occurrences of the problem.

id21.description: The date of the last occurrence of the problem.

id22.description: Information about one occurrence or exacerbation.

id23.description: A description of the exacerbation or occurrence.

id24.description: Outcome of the occurrence or exacerbation.

id25.description: Date of onset of occurrence or exacerbation.

id26.description: Number of times this problem has occurred or been apparent.

id27.description: Further problems that are related in some way to the index problem.

id28.description: A group of characteristics of the problem complicating the index problem.

id29.description: Identification of a related problem as text,coded text or link within the EHR.

id31.description: The date that the problem resolved or went into remission.

id32.description: The age of the person at the resolution of the problem.

id35.description: Reference to material about this condition.

id36.description: Useful information on the internet about this condition.

id37.description: Date of the resolution of the occurrence or exacerbation.

id38.description: Age at which the problem was recognised by a healthcare provider.

id39.description: Description of the clinical significance of the problem in terms of impact of the problem on the patient.

ac1.description: The assessed overall severity of the index problem. (synthesised)
